blockingLoop.evidence: "Sorry, I didn't quite catch which of these it is. Please check the temperature dial or display..." repeated after the customer had already answered; the vents question was likewise asked twice.

rationale: The customer asked directly what 22E means and the assistant never explained it (fridge-fan/ice fault), instead running a generic fridge-not-cooling checklist (door ajar, settings/eco mode, vents, seals) and repeating the settings and vents questions after they had been answered. It ignored the strong clue of very weak airflow plus the error code, mislabelled '9C' as a code, and never suggested the sensible manual-defrost test, Samsung service, or warranty check even when the customer asked whether an engineer was needed. Safety advice (food, don't remove covers) was sound and no parts were pushed, but after eight turns the homeowner has made essentially no diagnostic progress.
